system.description: The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
